response.overview: "TTTour de Taco" is the result of eight months of work by the jakotaco.fanserwis project, through which over 70 people have rolled. We have collected a few hundred hours of concert recordings and interviews with you. The film you have in front of you is one of the products of this work. Thank you for wanting to co-create this fantastic adventure as a fan. We hope that you will find yourself somewhere in the concert crowd.  [Jakotaco.fanserwis is in NO way affiliated with the 2020 label or the organizers of the "2026 TTTour" tour. Recordings from the concerts were recorded exclusively with the use of smartphones by fans. The jakotaco.fanserwis project and any of its members do not derive any financial benefit from the film and social media activities.]
response.title: TTTour de Taco
